# DEPLOY1R3 read-only final review

**Verdict: APPROVED** — DEPLOY1R2 residual **P2** (TS7016 on `smoke-pages.mjs`) is addressed on disk with a sibling `.d.mts` that matches the sole runtime export; root and web-tests typecheck paths both include the importing test; `ssg-dynamic-params.ts` is gone with no platform imports. No new actionable **P0–P2** in DEPLOY1R3 scope. (Disk only; no shell re-run.)

---

## 1. `smoke-pages.d.mts` vs `smoke-pages.mjs`

| Check | Evidence | Result |
|--------|----------|--------|
| Sole runtime export | `smoke-pages.mjs` has one `export`: `assertBasePrefixedNextAssets` (lines 99–111) | **Match** |
| Declaration surface | `smoke-pages.d.mts` declares only that symbol | **No over-broad `declare module` / `*.mjs` wildcard** (none in `platform/`) |
| Signature | Runtime: `(html, label, pagesBase = PAGES_BASE)`; d.mts: `(html: string, label: string, pagesBase?: string) => void` | **Aligned** (optional third arg; default stays runtime-only) |
| False “all exports typed” | No other exports in `.mjs`; only consumer is `deploy1r2-pages-smoke-hydration.test.ts`, which imports that name only | **Not masking missing exports** |
| Wrong-name imports | TS would reject unknown named imports; no `any` escape on the import line | **Errors not masked** |
| `.mjs` implementation typing | Body of `.mjs` still outside `tsc` `include` — pre-existing boundary; R3 only types the import surface | **Acceptable for packet scope** (not a new P2) |

The `.d.mts` comment correctly scopes intent to `assertBasePrefixedNextAssets` for root + web-tests typecheck, not a full module implementation check.

---

## 2. Root / web typecheck coverage (genuine)

| Gate | How the import is exercised |
|------|-----------------------------|
| Root `npm run typecheck` | `platform/tsconfig.json` includes `tests/web/**/*.ts`; `deploy1r2-pages-smoke-hydration.test.ts` is **not** in the UI/behavior exclude list |
| `npm run typecheck:web-tests` | `apps/web/tsconfig.tests.json` includes `../../tests/web/**/*.ts` (full web test tree, including DEPLOY1R2 hydration test) |
| `npm run check` | Chains `typecheck` + `typecheck:web` + `typecheck:web-tests` (per `platform/package.json`) |

Resolution mechanism on disk is the colocated ESM declaration (`smoke-pages.d.mts` next to `smoke-pages.mjs`), consistent with `moduleResolution: "bundler"` — not a shim that bypasses the real import path. No `declare module` ambient stubs for this path.

---

## 3. Deleted tombstone `ssg-dynamic-params.ts`

| Check | Evidence | Result |
|--------|----------|--------|
| On disk | `platform/apps/web/lib/content/ssg-dynamic-params.ts` → **not found** | **Absent** |
| Imports | Grep under `platform` `*.{ts,tsx,js,mjs}` → **no** `ssg-dynamic-params` references | **No dangling imports** |
| Packet intent | DEPLOY1R1 packet §2: delete unused file | **Satisfied on working tree** |

(Index/stage state for a phantom add was not verified without shell; disk + import graph support hygiene.)

---

## 4. New P0–P2 (DEPLOY1R3 scope)

| Severity | Finding |
|----------|---------|
| **P0** | None |
| **P1** | None |
| **P2** | None actionable — prior TS7016 gap is closed by accurate, minimal `.d.mts`; no regression in smoke logic (unchanged `.mjs` behavior per worker report) |

**P3** (tombstone / index cleanup) remains non-blocking for release approval.

---

## Honesty

- No commands re-run; approval based on staged-relevant disk artifacts (`smoke-pages.d.mts`, absent tombstone, tsconfig/test wiring).
- Worker-reported `npm run check` / `build:pages` / `smoke:pages` exits are cited in `DEPLOY1R3-worker-report.md` but not re-executed here.
